text.name: Pichu

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Pikachu from your hand onto Pichu (this counts as evolving Pichu) and remove all damage counters from Pichu.

attacks.name: Electric Circuit
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 4 {Lightning} Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

text.flavor: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

text.name: Giratina

attacks.name: Shadow Force
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Giratina during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Brutal Edge
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

text.name: Meowth

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

text.name: Glaceon

attacks.name: Ice Shot
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

text.name: Leafeon

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.

text.flavor: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

text.name: Chimchar

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

text.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for as many Eevee as you like and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

text.flavor: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

text.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

text.flavor: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

text.name: Turtwig
text.flavor: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

text.name: Dialga

attacks.name: Flash Cannon
attacks.text: You may return all Energy cards attached to Dialga to your hand. If you do, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from the Defending Pokémon and shuffle that card into your opponent's deck.

text.flavor: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

text.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Spacial Rend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If there is any Stadium card in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Transback
attacks.text: You may flip a coin. If heads, discard all Energy attached to Palkia and put the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your opponent's deck. Your opponent shuffles his or her deck afterward.

text.flavor: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
